notes.content: This hotfix addresses melee class weapons not being able to destroy Nukes. I figured it was best to do a hotfix for this since I wasn't sure when I'd be rolling out the next major update.

notes.title: Community Update
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/yKgzYCm.png[/img]

Update 1.0.2.2 provides players with a few items as suggested by the community from the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/396590/discussions/0/483366528925096457/]Suggestions for Future Development[/url] discussion thread.

Two new weapons have been added which include [b]Rapid Fire[/b] and [b]Melee[/b] weapon classes.

Rapid Fire is pretty self explanatory — Hold fire to shoot fast! The gun fires 300% faster than the vanilla single shot, but its range is limited to help balance the higher fire rate.

Melee comes in 4 cosmetic variants, which can be broken down into 2 classes — The battle axe and sword can perform a whirlwind attack which is great for CQC or when a pesky droid is chasing you from behind. The lance and partisan can dash-attack through crowds with ease.

[b][u]Please note[/u] that none of the melee weapons require that you actually use their ability to destroy enemies. You can simply run into objects nose-first and pop them like balloons.[/b]

Since these weapons are relatively new to the game, I'm interesting in knowing what you think about them and how they handle. As always, use the thread linked above to provide me with you comments.

notes.title: The Selfie Update
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/EdPKjcv.png[/img]

Update 1.0.2.1 provides a few small fixes, but includes a very important update nonetheless — [b][i]Selfies[/i][/b]! I goofed up when I originally released CMYW by not realizing that the Steam overlay doesn't govern screenshots. Thanks to the community for pointing this out.

[b][u]Highlights[/u][/b]
[list][*]The Steam screen capture button should function in game – Now you can share the chaos of space with the community!
[*]D-pad for controllers now function within menus.
[*]Mouse now functions with in-game menus i.e.) pause menu, summary screen.[/list]
